      "band": "Unranked",

      "reason_tag": "cleanup",

    },

    },

    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/rpc/blockchain.cpp by 1 line to expose the new deployment bit, alongside minor functional test adjustments.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Exposing an underlying consensus deployment bit in existing RPC output is routine and does not represent an RPC interface change."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Adds unit tests, JSON fixtures, functional tests, and a fuzz target exclusively dedicated to BIP 54 validation rules.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Tests and test fixtures that pin domain-specific behavior belong to that domain (validation) rather than test infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Implements BIP 54 consensus validation rules across src/validation.cpp, src/consensus/tx_verify.cpp, and src/consensus/consensus.h.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.7,
      "reason_tag": "DoS protection",
      "rationale": "Implements proposed soft fork consensus cleanup rules to address long-standing vulnerabilities like timewarp difficulty manipulation, 64-byte transaction Merkle tree ambiguity, and legacy sigops CPU exhaustion. Because the activation is confined to regtest, delay is not category-critical, but implementing and thoroughly vetting the consensus rules in Core provides substantial, strategic value for future network upgrades."
    },

      "rationale": "Incidental adjustments to wallet functional tests following consensus rule additions do not belong to wallet."
    }
